label: SYNTHETIC: Monte Carlo on the truth.make_wind model plus linearised analytic bounds

log_law_fit.value: u = alpha ln z + beta, u* = kappa alpha, z0 = exp(-beta/alpha)

s2_criterion.value: fitted z0 within a factor 10 of truth

sample_spacing_m.note: one wind sample every 2 m of height

height_ranges_m.note: 80-300 m is where image-derived winds exist

wind_model.note: truth.WindParams defaults, proposal Appendix I; not measured

anemometer_height_m.note: ground anemometer logged through the flight

anemometer_standard_error_m_s.note: standard error of the MEAN wind vector at 6 m, per axis

limits: SYNTHETIC: no measured wind profile enters any number here.
Neutral stratification only; no stability correction (Monin-Obukhov psi) is fitted.
The log law is assumed valid over the whole fitted range; in reality only the lowest ~50-100 m.
Frozen turbulence: the profile does not evolve during the ~28 s descent.
The turbulence kernel is the model's own (eddy scale = eddy_slope*z with no cap aloft); the GLS fit is told the true kernel and sigma_h unless the case name says otherwise.
Wind samples are taken as error-free except in the noise= cases; retrieval error, height error and canopy lag are not modelled.
Displacement height is zero and the upwind fetch is homogeneous.

definitions.ols: least squares of wind speed on ln z, uncertainty assuming independent residuals
definitions.gls: maximum likelihood on both components with the turbulence covariance, told sigma_h
definitions.frac_within_xK: Monte Carlo fraction of trials with |log10(z0_hat/z0)| < log10 K
definitions.coverage_ln_z0_68/95: fraction with truth inside the method's own +-1 / +-1.96 sd interval
definitions.coverage_profile_68/95: same for the GLS profile-likelihood interval
definitions.overconfidence: robust_sd of log10 z0 error divided by the median stated sd
definitions.analytic.cramer_rao: inverse Fisher information at truth (ANALYTIC, linearised)
definitions.analytic.gls_as_fitted: sandwich covariance of GLS with the covariance it was told
definitions.analytic.ols_on_component: sandwich covariance of OLS on the along-wind component

headline.note: Monte Carlo fractions; binomial standard error about 0.007 at 0.9 with 2000 profiles
